title: Critical-size Defect Augmentation Using Sintered and Non -Sintered Bovine Bone Matrix - An Experimental Controlled Study in Minipigs
authors: Schorn L, Fienitz T, De Donno F, Sterner-Kock A, Maul AC, Holtmann H, Lommen J, Rothamel D. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2021 Sep;79(9):1866-1873. doi: 10.1016/j.joms.2021.03.025.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “According to the results of this study, sintered bone substitute material remains histologically distinguishable but does not affect quantitative and qualitative bone regeneration” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
